comment: The associate in the TV department knew every model and walked me through the differences without pushing the most expensive one.
Order said ready for pickup in 1 hour. I waited 40 minutes at the pickup counter and nobody was staffing it.
Delivery window for my washer was 8am-5pm and the driver showed up at 6:30pm. I took the whole day off for nothing.
Switched carriers in under 30 minutes. Great experience, the phone specialist set up everything for me.
Website showed the console in stock at my store, drove 25 minutes, and it was actually sold out. Inventory on the site is not accurate.
Checkout line was 15 people deep with only two registers open on a Saturday.
Fast shipping and the headphones arrived a day early. Search on the app is clunky though, filters reset every time I go back.
Felt pressured to buy the protection plan. Asked three times if I was sure I didn't want it. Call me at 612-555-0148 if you want details.
Checked in for curbside pickup on the app and waited 25 minutes in the parking lot. Had to go inside anyway.
The camera specialist let me try three lenses on my own body. Super knowledgeable and patient.
Price match process is confusing. The website said one thing and the store said they could not match a marketplace seller.
Refrigerator install was rescheduled twice with no notice. Email me at jordan.r@example.com, I still do not have a working fridge.
Good help overall but the trade-in value quoted online was much higher than what I got in store.
App search for 'video doorbell' returned phone cases first. Had to use Google to find the product page on your own site.
Associate helped me load a 77 inch TV into my car and even double checked the mount I needed. Best service I have had anywhere.
Curbside pickup took over 30 minutes. The app said 'on the way out' the entire time.
Only one register open and a long line. I almost left my cart and bought online instead.
Delivery scheduling tool only offered dates two weeks out and then the truck never came on the scheduled day.
The home theater associate was honest and told me I did not need the more expensive receiver. Earned my trust.
Returns process online is unclear. I could not tell if I needed to bring the box or if I could ship it back.
The protection plan pitch happened at the register and again at the pickup counter. It was too much.
Site said available today at my store. Store said it was a display unit only. Inventory is wrong constantly.
Appliance specialist was great and measured my space with me. Delivery is the part that worries me after reading reviews.
Waited 20 minutes for curbside on a weekday afternoon with almost no other cars in the lot.
Long checkout wait on a weekend. Staff were friendly but clearly stretched thin.
Easy order online, but app search filters are broken on mobile. Sorting by price does not stick.
The phone specialist transferred all my photos and set up my watch. Would recommend to anyone.
Dishwasher install crew left without hooking it up because of a 'missing part'. Nobody called to reschedule. My number is (651) 555-0192.
Price match denied because the competitor was 'out of stock' at the time. Policy is confusing and inconsistent.
Knowledgeable staff in the TV area, explained HDR formats clearly and did not upsell me.
Curbside pickup wait was 35 minutes. Next time I will just walk in.
Inventory said 5 in stock nearby. All three stores I called had zero.
The tech support desk set up my laptop and migrated data quickly. Wait to get to the counter was long though.
Asked to return a monitor within the window and was told I needed the original receipt even though it is in my account.
Delivery of the TV was fine but the scheduling text messages were confusing and contradicted each other.
Specialist was a working photographer and gave advice I could not get online.
Felt pushed into adding the protection plan and a screen protector I did not ask for.
App is fine for ordering but search results are not relevant. Typing a model number returned accessories.
Range delivery was a no-show and customer service hold time was over an hour.
Curbside was slow, about 20 minutes, but the associate apologized and was friendly.
